tagline.zh: 读仓库的 README 与 docs/*.png，生成一张可直接贴进上架 PR 的卡片：中英双语标题、安装命令、截图墙、能力与限制，输出静态 HTML 与 2x PNG。
tagline.en: Turn a repository's README and docs/*.png into a publishable market card: bilingual title, install command, screenshot wall, capabilities and limitations, as static HTML and a 2x PNG.

zh: 从 README 与 docs/*.png 提取中英标题、安装命令和最多 4 张截图
输出自包含 HTML、2x PNG、可直接粘贴的 card.md 和带 provenance 的 card.json
字段不全时 --strict 拒绝出图，否则盖 DRAFT 章并列出待补字段
在对话视图的「市场卡片」面板里生成、预览并复制安装命令
en: Extracts bilingual titles, the install command and up to four screenshots from README and docs/*.png
Writes self-contained HTML, a 2x PNG, a paste-ready card.md and a provenance-rich card.json
Refuses to render with --strict when a required field is missing; otherwise stamps DRAFT and lists the gaps
Generates, previews and copies the install command from the 市场卡片 panel in the chat view

zh: 必须装有 Chrome / Edge；找不到时仍写 HTML，PNG 报 browser-missing，退出码 3
卡片固定 1200px 宽、不响应式，超过 16000px 高会拒绝出图
提取是启发式的：标题取首个加粗短语、安装命令取第一个代码块，怪结构要靠 market-card.json 覆盖
不做机器翻译、不生成事实、不推断市场分类，也不上传任何内容
en: Needs a local Chrome or Edge; without one it still writes HTML, but PNG fails with browser-missing and exit code 3
The card is a fixed 1200px wide editorial layout, and is refused above 16000px tall
Extraction is heuristic: the first bold phrase becomes the title and the first shell fence the install command
No machine translation, no invented facts, no inferred market category, and nothing leaves the machine
